messages:
amira: hi all :wave: first day question. trying to run a quick integration that needs an AWS assume-role into our onboarding account and a small GCP vm in redwood-onboard-eu (europe-west2). two blockers: 1) AWS returns 'AccessDenied: MFA required' when I run assume-role, and 2) GCP project shows 'No billing account linked' even though people-ops sent an invite. who should I ping to attach billing and how do I get past the MFA require?

rick: welcome amira! short answers: for billing ping @olivia (people-ops) and infra can attach if invite acceptance is weird. for AWS MFA, onboarding roles sometimes require IAM SSO or a session with MFA. paste the exact aws CLI command and the error.

amira: thanks. aws command i ran: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/Redwood-Onboard --role-session-name amira-cli
```
error: "An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: User requires MFA"
for GCP i accepted the invite but the project still says billing not linked. i clicked the link from my email.

olivia: hey amira! i re-sent the billing invite and confirmed your invite was accepted, strange that project still isn't linked. infra can attach billing if you confirm the project-id. sending billing-account id in DM.

rick: two AWS tips: 1) if role requires MFA the usual flow is to get temporary credentials via STS GetSessionToken with MFA then call AssumeRole using those creds, or 2) use our SSO profile which handles MFA automatically. example: 
```
aws sts get-session-token --serial-number arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:mfa/amira --token-code 123456
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=...
aws sts assume-role --role-arn <role> --role-session-name amira-cli
```
if you don't have an MFA device setup, ping security to provision.

security-bot: Hi Amira, MFA required by policy for onboarding roles. To setup MFA: follow https://redwood.internal/security/mfa-setup and register an authenticator app. If you need a temporary bypass for a developer-critical task, request a one-time exemption via infra form and CC @security.

amira: i followed the MFA setup doc and registered my phone app. tried the get-session-token flow and now assume-role works! thanks. on billing: i accepted the resend but project still shows unlinked when I run:
```
gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-onboard-eu
```
it prints: "billingAccountName: \"\""

infra-setup-bot: ticket INF-9123 created to attach billing for redwood-onboard-eu. Action: verify invite acceptance and attach billing-account 9999-0000-1111 if needed. ETA 2 hours. If project was created by non-admin require manager approval.

olivia: i see the invite was accepted but the acceptance came from a forwarded email (known bug). i'll ask infra to attach billing; also confirming your manager approved the project link.

amira: thanks all, infra ticket INF-9123 noted. i'll wait for the attach and re-try the VM create. once billing is attached i'll post the create command here. appreciate the quick help :pray:

rick: nice work getting MFA sorted. once INF-9123 closes try this gcloud to create a tiny vm:
```
gcloud compute instances create onboard-test --project=redwood-onboard-eu --zone=europe-west2-b --machine-type=e2-small
```
if you hit an org-policy about allowed regions ping infra and we'll request a temporary exception for onboarding tests. :rocket:
